title: Shopify shipping options move to rateGroups; rateProvider and methodConditions are legacy
summary: A shipping option can now hold several tiered rates. DeliveryMethodDefinition.rateGroups and DeliveryRateDefinition.conditions replace the legacy rateProvider and methodConditions fields, and apps that write merchant-managed delivery profiles must move to the new write API.
migrationNote: Read shipping options from DeliveryMethodDefinition.rateGroups and DeliveryRateDefinition.conditions, and use the new write API for merchant-managed delivery profiles; app-managed profiles need no change.
